- .claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md (identical copy: workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s25-pr-watching-disabled.md):55 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The PR added both copies of this file, and line 55 carries the retired token `send_later`. `tests/test_no_session_automation.py::test_no_session_automation_remains` scans `.claude/` and `workflow-templates/` and rejects it. Moving the §25.C text out of CLAUDE.md, which the scan does not cover, brought it under the scan.
  WHY: CI job `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` fails (1 failed, 252 passed), which fails the `lint` aggregate on head 211854e and blocks merge. The fix is to reword line 55 identically in both copies, for example "(the session scheduler, Routines)". CLAUDE.md §25.C (line 1231 on the base) should change in the same commit. The two copies must stay byte-identical, and no test exemption should be added.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The PR description says the go on a §31 plan "counts as the §23.C approval for opening issues or dispatching". Each reference file claims to be "the full text of CLAUDE.md §NN", and both are binding.
  Expected change site: the "Command-invoked dispatches are already approved" paragraph of §23.C in .claude/docs/s23-github-access.md and workflow-templates/.claude/docs/s23-github-access.md
  Evidence of absence: The condensed CLAUDE.md §23.C ends with "Likewise, the user's go on a §31 plan approves opening the issues (or the orchestrator dispatch) that plan names." Both s23 reference copies end that paragraph with "...covers dispatches you would be initiating on your own judgement." and lack the sentence. The changelog and `agents.d/8250-claude-md-reference-docs.md` both claim the reference holds the full text.
  severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The changelog line 4 and the PR description say the moved text is "copied verbatim" / "word for word", and "no rule was dropped".
  Expected change site: changelog.d/8250-claude-md-plan-handoff.md line 4, and the PR description
  Evidence of absence: The reference files are verbatim copies of the pre-PR text today. The claim stops being accurate once the two edits above land. The "word for word" claim in the PR description already overstates things, because §25.A–C stay in CLAUDE.md and only §25.D is condensed. Soften the wording to "moved with minimal edits" in the same commit.
  severity=NIT | confidence=3
